tha-ap45:1.1: Bhaddiya-Kaḷigodhāya-putta.] Padumuttarasambuddhaṃ mettacittaṃ mahāmuniṃ / upeti janatā sabbā sabbalokagganāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap45:2.1: Satthukañ ca 'baddhakañ ca āmisaṃ pānabhojanaṃ / dadanti satthuno sabbe puññakkhette anuttare. // //
tha-ap45:3.1: Ahaṃ pi dānaṃ dassāmi devadevassa tādino / buddhaseṭṭhaṃ nimantetvā saṅgham pi ca anuttaraṃ. // //
tha-ap45:4.1: Uyyojitā mayā c' ete nimantesuṃ Tathāgataṃ / kevalaṃ bhikkhusaṅghañ ca puññakkhettaṃ anuttaraṃ. // //
tha-ap45:5.1: Sataṃ sahassaṃ pallaṅkaṃ sovaṇṇaṃ gonakatthataṃ / tulikā paṭalikāya khomakappāsikehi ca / mahārahaṃ paññāpayim āsanaṃ Buddhayuttakaṃ. // //
tha-ap45:6.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū devadevo narāsabho / bhikkhusaṅghaparibbūḷho mama dvāraṃ upāgami. // //
tha-ap45:7.1: Paccuggantvāna sambuddhaṃ lokanāthaṃ yasassinaṃ / pasannacitto sumano atināmayiṃ sagharaṃ. // //
tha-ap45:8.1: Bhikkhūnaṃ satasahassaṃ Buddhañ ca lokanāyakaṃ / pasannacitto sumano paramannena tappayiṃ. // //
tha-ap45:9.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap45:10.1: ‘Yen idaṃ āsanaṃ dinnaṃ sovaṇṇaṃ gonakatthataṃ / Tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap45:11.1: Catusattatikkhattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati / anubhossati sampattiṃ accharāhi purakkhato. // //
tha-ap45:12.1: Padesarajjaṃ sahassaṃ vasudhaṃ āvasissati / ekapaññāsakkhattuñ cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap45:13.1: Sabbāsu bhavayonīsu uccākulī bhavissati / so ca pacchā pabbajitvā sukkamūlena codito / Bhaddiyo nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako.' // //
tha-ap45:14.1: Vivekam anuyutto 'mhi pantasenanivās' ahaṃ / phalañ c' avigataṃ sabbaṃ vattakeso 'mhi ajja 'haṃ. // //
tha-ap45:15.1: Mama sabbaṃ abhiññāya sabbaññū lokanāyako / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā etadagge ṭhapesi maṃ. // //
tha-ap45:16.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap45:17.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Bhaddiyo Kaḷigodhāyaputto thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
